title: Why is the command at the moment of victory to ask forgiveness?

beats.narration: At the moment of total victory, the Qur'an's command is to ask forgiveness. Why?
Help has arrived. The door has opened. Crowds are streaming in. And the response commanded is to praise your Lord and seek His forgiveness. As if pardon were victory's proper consequence.
The verse gives its reason. He has always been tawwab, the one who turns back toward you. It is the word from the first human story, when Adam fell and God turned back towards him.
Victory, the surah insists, was never yours to own. It was His help all along. The higher the arrival, the deeper the turning back.
